heading: Remove the limits
intro: This hosted version applies limits to stay free and stable. Croma is open source: run it yourself and set your own limits.
currentLimits: This version: {files} files · {mb} MB per file.

local.title: 1. Run it locally
local.intro: No database, no configuration. Requires Node.js 20.9 or newer.
local.note: Local default: 30 files / 50 MB. To raise them, set NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_FILES and NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_FILE_MB before building.

railway.title: 2. Deploy on Railway
railway.intro: Your own instance in one click. No database and no required variables.
railway.note: Behind a proxy/custom domain, set TRUST_FORWARDED_HOST=true (or list your domain in ALLOWED_ORIGINS). For conservative limits use NEXT_PUBLIC_HOST=server. Legal pages are hidden unless NEXT_PUBLIC_LEGAL=on. Health check at /api/health.
